instruction: Review invoice INV-56 against purchase order PO-62. Determine the payable amount, disputed items, approved line items, and excluded invoice lines. Only lines referencing PO-62 belong to this review. Lines not in the PO are disputed. Return only a JSON object: payable_amount, disputed_items, approved_line_items, excluded_lines. payable_amount must be the total approved for payment. disputed_items must be an array of short snake_case labels for invoice items not in the PO. approved_line_items must be an array of short snake_case labels for items matching the PO. excluded_lines must be an array of short snake_case labels for invoice lines from other invoices or different POs. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: N1 is INV-55 (different invoice) → excluded. L1+L2 match PO-62 exactly → payable 1200+1200=2400. L3 rush surcharge not in PO → disputed. payable_amount=2400.
